scope.admission: Read-only exact live review envelope bound to the official pending tool execution, agent, session and cancellation signal
scope.default: Preserve the native reviewer policy, decision parsing, approval fallback and lifecycle
scope.boundary: Only classifyRisk publishes; finally always clears. The host still verifies current accepted work, tool execution and permission mode. Copies and replay grant no proof.
scope.budget: Use the existing finite request-header output cap; each reviewed tool receives an independent model operation identity.
